description: Page precincts whose centroid falls inside the district boundary, in precinct-id order. Returns at most 100 rows plus total_precincts, returned, has_more and next_offset. Repeat with next_offset and unchanged filters…

district_id.description: External id of the district (e.g. "4207" for PA-07).

offset.description: Use the previous next_offset with unchanged district and filters.

state.description: Hint state to restrict the precinct search (FIPS or abbr). Strongly recommended for perf.

workspace_scope.description: Optional workspace for THIS call: use an exact personal/team ID from list_workspaces. Repeat on each call; it does not change the connection default. Must agree with MCP metadata and the effective HTTP workspace selector (header, otherwise connector URL). OAuth connections can only use their granted workspace. Membership and campaign permissions still apply.

name: precincts_in_district
